trend: Cottage-cheese-based ice cream and frozen dessert tubs
product_trend_description: Cottage cheese ice cream is a viral high-protein TikTok recipe and US brands have launched it as a product, while UK cottage cheese spend rose 41.9% in 2025 and UK shops mostly sell it only as a pot of cheese.
